punchline: Pig farm workers were diagnosed with a familiar disease until someone grew the virus and found a new one.
thirty_sec: In 1998 pig farm workers in Perak, Malaysia fell ill with encephalitis that was first diagnosed as Japanese encephalitis. In March 1999 Dr Chua Kaw Bing isolated a new virus, named Nipah after a village; 265 people fell ill and 105 died.
question: Which first explanation are you defending although several things keep contradicting it?
key_contrast: Test the first label when the cases stop fitting it.
